description: Mountain Range, a long ridge country split by a shallow river with the start in the south-west valley: Deep Frontier puts one Deep Ore Vein on the north highland across the river and one in the south valley, two finite Deep Ore Sources (4,000 DeepOre) on the east and north benches, stone outcrops beside their pits east of the start and the launch pad on the south valley terrace; there is no reactor-sized flat and no natural shore-fishing bank.

unmet.reason: In the saved water only 68 cells of clean water (contamination <= 0.01) are at least 0.5 deep (the median clean depth is 0.40). Of their 272 neighbour cells, 267 are themselves shallow water and the other 5 are dry banks whose water surface lies more than 1.25 below the bank, so no bank anywhere on the map meets ShoreFishing.Suitable (MinimumDepth 0.5, MaximumReachDown 1.25); the river has to be dammed deeper in play first.

The reactor needs a flat, dry, object-free 20x15 footprint; a scan of every terrain level finds none in either orientation. The largest flat dry rectangles are 23x13 at level 5, 10x28 at level 4, 14x17 at level 13 and 37x5 at level 1.
